scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.mobile:android: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.mobile:ios:simulator: npm run mobile:sync && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -sdk iphonesimulator -configuration Debug CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.mobile:android:debug: npm run mobile:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
